now: Training v2 on 861 teacher/DAgger games; new DAgger games with feature version 2 are generating.

plan.text: Features from the stdio/replay observation (no hidden info)
Teacher-labelled games: heuristic search labels at a third of action windows
Train encoder + value + policy + dynamics heads in tinygrad
Beat random with the pure policy (learned-pi)
DAgger round: v0 plays, teacher labels its positions; retrain
Retrain on DAgger data (v2) and rerun the ladder with more games
Use the dynamics head for lookahead without the engine

thoughts.text: The heuristic teacher costs 1-3 s per searched decision, so only a third of action windows get a search label; other prompts use its cheap rule-based choice.
Switched training from JAX to tinygrad. The JS forward pass matches tinygrad to 1e-5 on held-out decisions.
v0 (141 training games): copies the teacher on 50% of held-out action windows (chance 18%) and 78% of other prompts (chance 28%). Value head overfits: held-out MSE 1.33 vs 1.0 for always guessing 0.
learned-pi v0 beats random 29-11 (73%, 95% CI 59-86%) with no search, ~1 ms a decision.
Fixes: 3x more teacher games, random games for the value head, stronger weight decay, and DAgger data so the policy learns from its own mistakes.

v1 (411 teacher games + 197 random games for value): copies the teacher on 60% of held-out action windows and 82% of other prompts. Still 29-10 vs random: better copying did not add wins, so the gap to the teacher is in target choice, not in when to pass.

The value head still overfits after ~1000 steps (held-out MSE 0.82 at best). Value data is a few hundred games, and positions inside one game are near copies: it needs many more games, not more steps.

Ladder learned-v1 (4 games per pair): learned-v 11-1, heuristic 8-4, learned-pi 4-8, random 1-11. The value head plus one-ply engine search beat the hand-written evaluation 3-1 head to head, and took 30-90 s a game vs 100-270 s for the heuristic. Small sample: the 95% interval is wide.
